title: No Verified Arrest Record Can Carry an Honest Pet-Theft Story
excerpt: No dated arrest, seizure, verdict, or named victim record appears here. SDE must demand abolition without inventing evidence or weakening the case for reform.
body_html:
No police seizure, court verdict, intercepted shipment, or named stolen pet appears in the material available for this dispatch. That absence blocks any honest claim about stun guns, poison bait, cages, transport routes, or syndicate arrests. Families whose companions vanish deserve documented truth—not invented scenes built for outrage.

Evidence must protect victims

Pet theft is a grave crime when documented. Criminal operators should face investigation, prosecution, and accountability. But no defendant, court, case number, location, date, quantity, or police agency is identified here. Claims about forged quarantine certificates, extreme transport conditions, or stolen animals cannot be presented as fact without records.

Biosecurity still demands precision

Rabies exposure generally occurs when infected saliva enters bites, scratches, broken skin, or mucous membranes. Once clinical symptoms appear, rabies is virtually 100% fatal. After possible exposure, wash wounds with soap and running water for at least 15 minutes and seek urgent medical assessment. Post-exposure prophylaxis includes vaccination and, when indicated, rabies immunoglobulin or approved monoclonal antibodies. Properly cooked meat is not an established rabies transmission route. WHO guidance separates household exposure risks from claims about commercial supply chains.

Vietnamese communities deserve accountable reform

Families, veterinarians, police, courts, and health authorities need transparent records, strict quarantine enforcement, and protection for companion animals. SDE’s campaign demand goes further: complete abolition of the dog meat trade by 2030. Sign the national petition. Add your name to a public demand for action—and follow campaign updates on how that demand reaches decision-makers.
